# Parser fixture

Real README lines that stream_parser.py must keep parsing the same way, plus one synthetic case. If you change the parser on purpose, regenerate parser_expected.tsv.

- [Apps & Players](#apps-players)

### Ambient, Lo-Fi & Chill <a id="ambient-lo-fi-chill"></a>

- ⭐ [9128](https://9128.live): Ambient and drone from the *A Strangely Isolated Place* label. [Stream](https://streams.radio.co/s0aa1e6f4a/listen)
- ⭐ [Echoes of Bluemars](http://echoesofbluemars.org/): Archived tribute to Bluemars, the ambient stream that went dark in 2013. [Bluemars](http://streams.echoesofbluemars.org:8000/bluemars) / [Cryosleep](http://streams.echoesofbluemars.org:8000/cryosleep) / [Voices From Within](http://streams.echoesofbluemars.org:8000/voicesfromwithin)
- [Sleepscapes](https://www.willstare.com/sleep/): Rain and ocean waves for sleep, from the creator of an Art Bell archive. [Rain](https://stream.willstare.com:8850/,) / [Waves](https://stream.willstare.com:8860/,)
- [Subsonic Radio](https://www.subsonicradio.com/): Unofficial recordings from Disney theme-park attractions, resorts, and parades, across 16 channels since the mid-2000s. [SR One](https://www.subsonicradio.com:8443/requests.mp3) / [SR Two - Extended Plays](https://www.subsonicradio.com:8443/longbois.mp3) / [WEDWay PeopleMover](https://www.subsonicradio.com:8443/wedway.mp3)
### Classical & Opera <a id="classical-opera"></a>

- [RCO Live](https://www.concertgebouworkest.nl/nl/radio/): Archival concert recordings from the Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra, Amsterdam. *(down)* [Stream](https://ice.cr1.streamzilla.xlcdn.com:8000/sz=RCOLiveWebradio=mp3-192)
### Global Independent & Online Communities <a id="global-indie-radio"></a>

- [Aaja Music](https://aajamusic.com/): Electronic and DJ sets from a bar in a Deptford railway arch, London. [Channel 1](https://aaja.radiocult.fm/stream) / [Channel 2](https://aaja-2.radiocult.fm/stream)
- ⭐ [NTS](https://www.nts.live/): Founded in Hackney in 2011, DJs from 80+ countries, two channels, and a vast mixtape archive. ([1](http://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream), [2](http://stream-relay-geo.ntslive.net/stream2)) and [mixtapes](https://www.nts.live/infinite-mixtapes).
### Rock, Indie, Alternative, Country & Folk <a id="rock-indie-alternative-country-folk"></a>

- [BBC Radio 6 Music](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live/bbc_6music): Alternative music, new releases, and deep cuts. [Stream](http://as-hls-ww-live.akamaized.net/pool_81827798/live/ww/bbc_6music/bbc_6music.isml/bbc_6music-audio%3d320000.norewind.m3u8) ([More BBC streams](https://gist.github.com/bpsib/67089b959e4fa898af69fea59ad74bc3))
### Christmas & Holiday <a id="christmas-music-holiday"></a>

- [SomaFM - Holiday Broadcasts](https://somafm.com/holiday/): Various holiday channels, returns in October.

### Synthetic Cases

- [Down After Stream](https://example.org/): Down note after the streams. [Stream](https://example.org/live) / [Backup](https://example.org/backup) *(down, since 2026)*
